A busy intersection with a traffic light showing green, yellow, and red signals against a clear blue sky
words.image_desc_en: A line of cars at a red light on a rainy street, or a traffic light at a busy intersection.

words.usage: n. (不可数名词)
words.collocations: heavy traffic, traffic jam, traffic light, traffic rule

examples.en: There is heavy traffic on the road every morning.
examples.cn: 每天早上路上交通都很拥堵。

socratic_questions.question: 你早上坐车去学校，发现路上全是车，开得很慢，这时候你会说路上什么很严重？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 路上车多、行驶缓慢，通常用 'heavy traffic' 或 'traffic jam' 来形容，核心词是 'traffic'。

image_prompts: A modern laptop with a glowing screen showing code, next to a smartphone and a wireless mouse on a wooden desk

words.image_desc_en: A laptop, smartphone, and mouse on a desk, or robotic arms in a factory assembling a car.
words.image_desc_cn: 桌上放着笔记本电脑、智能手机和鼠标，或工厂里组装汽车的机械臂。
words.usage: n. (可数/不可数名词，复数 technologies)
words.collocations: modern technology, information technology, technology company

examples.en: Modern technology helps us learn English more easily.
examples.cn: 现代科技帮助我们更轻松地学习英语。

examples.en: Many schools use new technology in the classroom.
examples.cn: 许多学校在教室里使用新技术。

socratic_questions.question: 你发现现在可以用手机查单词、用电脑看教学视频，这些工具都属于什么领域？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 手机、电脑、互联网这些工具和知识都属于 'technology'（科技/技术）的范畴。

sentences: The rapid development of ___ has changed our daily life.

image_prompts: A smartphone screen playing a nature documentary with a waterfall and green forest, play button visible
A stack of old VHS tapes on a shelf next to a dusty VCR player

words.usage: n. (可数名词，复数 videos); v. (过去式 videoed, 过去分词 videoed) 录制视频
words.collocations: watch a video, make a video, video game, video call

examples.cn: 我看了一个关于如何做蛋糕的短视频。

examples.cn: 我们可以把学校旅行录成视频并分享到网上。

socratic_questions.question: 你想记录下周末去动物园的见闻，回家后可以给朋友看，你会用什么方式记录？

image_prompts: A yellow school bus driving on a tree-lined road, autumn leaves falling, clear sky
A bicycle parked next to a subway entrance sign, morning sunlight on the metal frame
words.image_desc_en: A yellow school bus on a road with autumn trees; a bicycle by a subway entrance in morning light.
words.image_desc_cn: 一辆黄色校车行驶在秋叶飘落的道路上；一辆自行车停在地铁入口旁，晨光照在金属车架上。

socratic_questions.question: 小明每天坐地铁上学，地铁属于哪种方式？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 地铁是公共的、载人移动的工具，所以是“交通/运输”方式。

sentences: Buses and trains are common forms of public ___.

A set of interconnected gears inside a clock, brass and steel, precise alignment
words.image_desc_en: A subway map with colored lines and station dots; clock gears interlocked in a metal frame.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张彩色地铁线路图，站点用圆点标记；钟表内部相互咬合的金属齿轮组。
words.usage: n. (可数) 系统
words.collocations: education system, transport system, computer system
words.preposition_combos: system of rules, system for doing sth.

examples.en: Our school has a good education system for students.
examples.cn: 我们学校有一个良好的教育体系。

examples.cn: 新的电脑系统帮助我们更快完成工作。

socratic_questions.question: 学校有上课、考试、放假等安排，这些合起来叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这些规则和流程组合在一起形成一个整体，叫做“系统”。

sentences: The public transport ___ in this city is very convenient.

image_prompts: A solar-powered calculator on a desk, bright sunlight through a window, no wires
A single water droplet falling onto a plant leaf, clean and precise, no waste
words.image_desc_en: A solar calculator on a desk in sunlight; a water droplet on a green leaf, no splashing.
words.image_desc_cn: 桌上太阳能计算器在阳光下工作；一滴水精准落在绿叶上，没有溅开。
words.usage: adj. (副词 efficiently)
words.collocations: efficient way, efficient system, efficient worker

examples.en: This new bus system is more efficient than the old one.
examples.cn: 这个新公交系统比旧的更高效。

examples.cn: 她找到了一个高效的方法快速完成作业。

socratic_questions.question: 小华用半小时做完作业，而别人要两小时，小华的方法怎么样？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 用更少时间做同样的事，说明方法很“高效”。

sentences: Using a planner is an ___ way to manage your time.

words.image_desc_en: A stack of textbooks and a globe on a desk in a library; a blackboard with math equations in chalk.
words.image_desc_cn: 图书馆桌上的一摞课本和一个地球仪；黑板上用粉笔写的数学公式和图形。
words.usage: n. (不可数) 教育
words.collocations: education system, get a good education, physical education
words.preposition_combos: education in science, education for all

examples.en: Every child should have the right to a good education.
examples.cn: 每个孩子都应该享有良好教育的权利。

socratic_questions.question: 你在学校学知识、学做人，这个过程叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 学校提供的学习知识和培养能力的过程就是“教育”。

sentences: The government spends a lot of money on public ___.

words.usage: n. (可数名词，常与 of 连用)
words.collocations: the length of, full length, arm's length, at length
words.preposition_combos: in length, of length, at length

examples.en: The length of the bridge is over two hundred meters.
examples.cn: 这座桥的长度超过两百米。

examples.cn: 请把绳子剪到和桌子一样长。

socratic_questions.question: 你想知道从教室前门到后门有多远，应该问什么词？

image_prompts: A whiteboard with the word 'Environment' written in blue marker, surrounded by colorful sticky notes

words.image_desc_en: A whiteboard with a word and sticky notes; an open textbook with a highlighted title.
words.image_desc_cn: 一块写着单词并贴满便签的白板；一本打开的书，标题被荧光笔标记。
words.usage: n. (可数名词)
words.collocations: main topic, hot topic, discuss a topic, change the topic
words.preposition_combos: on the topic of, about a topic

examples.en: Our group chose the topic of school sports for the report.
examples.cn: 我们小组选择了学校体育作为报告主题。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to write about a topic we like.

socratic_questions.question: 英语课上老师让大家选一个感兴趣的内容来讨论，这个内容叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指讨论或写作的中心内容，比如 the ___ of the conversation。

sentences: We need to decide on a ___ for our class debate.

image_prompts: Two identical blue notebooks placed side by side on a wooden desk, with two pens crossed between them

words.image_desc_cn: 两本笔记本和交叉的笔；两只运动鞋用鞋带系在一起。
words.usage: n. (可数名词)
words.collocations: work partner, dance partner, business partner, partner up

socratic_questions.question: 老师让大家两人一组做练习，和你一起做的那个人叫什么？

socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示成功达到标准或把东西递给别人，和考试、传递动作有关。

A blue first-place medal lying on a checkered finish line with confetti around

words.collocations: the winner of the game, a lucky winner, winner takes all

image_prompts: A glass bottle of orange medicine with a spoon next to it on a white table

A calculator sitting on top of a stack of textbooks, desk lamp shining
words.image_desc_en: Crutches leaning against a wall; a calculator on textbooks under a lamp.
words.image_desc_cn: 拐杖靠在墙边；计算器放在课本上，台灯亮着。
words.usage: phrasal verb (过去式 depended on, 过去分词 depended on)
words.collocations: depend on sb/sth for sth

examples.en: You can depend on the map to find the way.
examples.cn: 你可以靠地图找到路。

examples.en: The picnic depends on the weather this weekend.
examples.cn: 野餐取决于这个周末的天气。

socratic_questions.question: 小红要完成小组作业，但她的电脑坏了，她需要借用同学的电脑。这时可以用哪个短语表示‘依靠’？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语由两个词组成，表示需要某物或某人的帮助。

sentences: We can ___ ___ the library for research materials.

image_prompts: A bicycle parked outside a front door with a welcome mat, sunny afternoon
A stack of board games on a coffee table next to two empty cups
words.image_desc_en: A bicycle by a front door with a welcome mat; board games on a coffee table.
words.image_desc_cn: 自行车停在前门外，门口有迎宾垫；咖啡桌上放着桌游和两个空杯子。
words.usage: phrasal verb (过去式 came over, 过去分词 come over)
words.collocations: come over to + place

examples.en: My friend will come over after school today.
examples.cn: 我的朋友今天放学后会过来。

examples.en: Please come over to my house this Saturday.
examples.cn: 请这个周六来我家玩。

socratic_questions.question: 小华邀请同学周末来家里一起复习功课，同学答应了。这时可以用哪个短语表示‘到某人家来’？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语由两个词组成，表示从别处移动到说话人所在的地方。

sentences: Can you ___ ___ to my place and help me with math?

image_prompts: A green traffic light glowing against a blue sky, empty crosswalk
A key inserted into a lock with a golden glow around the keyhole
words.image_desc_en: A green traffic light on a clear day; a key in a lock with a golden glow.
words.image_desc_cn: 晴朗天空下的绿灯；钥匙插入锁孔，周围有金色光芒。
words.usage: conj. (连词，引导条件状语从句)
words.collocations: as long as + 从句

examples.en: You can borrow my book as long as you return it.
examples.cn: 只要你还回来，你就可以借我的书。

examples.en: We will win the game as long as we work together.
examples.cn: 只要我们合作，我们就会赢比赛。

socratic_questions.question: 妈妈对小明说：‘只要你做完作业，就可以看电视。’这里表示条件的短语是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语由三个词组成，意思是‘在……条件下’。

sentences: You can join the club ___ ___ ___ you follow the rules.
